categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/streams.h` to change `BufferedWriter` error handling and buffer clearing semantics.
categories.rationale: Fixes an abrupt `std::terminate` crash caused by throwing exceptions during `BufferedWriter` destruction on write failures. Reviewers noted this provides a safer primitive interface by ensuring failed flushes do not re-throw during exception unwinding and requiring explicit flush or discard.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Changes block and undo write handling in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Prevents unexpected node crashes when disk writes fail during block and undo serialization. Handling write failures explicitly ensures that conditions like a full disk trigger diagnostic logging and clean fatal shutdown rather than an unhandled crash.
